description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: Paul urges Timothy to stay in Ephesus and stop people from teaching a different doctrine, since the aim of instruction is love. He gives thanks that Jesus showed mercy to him, the worst of sinners, and charges Timothy to fight the good fight.
1.sw: Paulo anamhimiza Timotheo abaki Efeso na kuwazuia watu wasifundishe mafundisho tofauti, kwa kuwa lengo la mafundisho ni upendo. Anashukuru kwamba Yesu alimhurumia yeye, mbaya kuliko wenye dhambi wote, na kumwagiza Timotheo apigane vita vizuri.
1.am: ጳውሎስ ጢሞቴዎስ በኤፌሶን እንዲቆይና ሰዎች የተለየ ትምህርት እንዳያስተምሩ እንዲከለክል ያሳስበዋል፤ የትምህርቱ ዓላማ ፍቅር ነውና። ከኃጢአተኞች ሁሉ የከፋው እርሱ ሆኖ ሳለ ኢየሱስ ስለ ማረው ያመሰግናል፤ ጢሞቴዎስም መልካሙን ገድል እንዲጋደል አደራ ይለዋል።

2.en: Paul asks that prayers be offered for everyone, including rulers, because God wants all to be saved and there is one mediator between God and humanity. He then gives instructions about how men are to pray and how women are to conduct themselves.
2.sw: Paulo anaomba sala zifanywe kwa ajili ya kila mtu, pamoja na watawala, kwa sababu Mungu anataka wote waokolewe na kuna mpatanishi mmoja kati ya Mungu na wanadamu. Kisha anatoa maagizo kuhusu jinsi wanaume wanavyopaswa kuomba na jinsi wanawake wanavyopaswa kujiendesha.
2.am: ጳውሎስ ገዦችን ጨምሮ ለሰው ሁሉ ጸሎት እንዲቀርብ ይለምናል፤ እግዚአብሔር ሁሉም እንዲድኑ ይፈልጋልና፤ በእግዚአብሔርና በሰዎች መካከልም አንድ መካከለኛ አለ። ከዚያም ወንዶች እንዴት መጸለይ እንዳለባቸውና ሴቶች እንዴት መመላለስ እንዳለባቸው መመሪያ ይሰጣል።

3.en: Paul sets out the qualities required of overseers and of deacons, who must lead blameless lives and manage their households well. He writes so that Timothy will know how people should live in God's household, the church, and he speaks of the great mystery of the faith.
3.sw: Paulo anaeleza sifa zinazotakiwa kwa waangalizi na kwa mashemasi, ambao lazima waishi maisha yasiyo na lawama na kusimamia nyumba zao vizuri. Anaandika ili Timotheo ajue jinsi watu wanavyopaswa kuishi katika nyumba ya Mungu, yaani kanisa, na kuzungumza kuhusu siri kuu ya imani.
3.am: ጳውሎስ ነቀፋ የሌለበት ሕይወት ሊኖሩና ቤተሰባቸውን በሚገባ ሊያስተዳድሩ ለሚገባቸው ለጠባቂዎችና ለዲያቆናት የሚያስፈልጉትን ባሕርያት ይዘረዝራል። ሰዎች በእግዚአብሔር ቤት፣ በቤተ ክርስቲያን፣ እንዴት ሊኖሩ እንደሚገባ ጢሞቴዎስ እንዲያውቅ ይጽፋል፤ ስለ ታላቁ የእምነት ምሥጢርም ይናገራል።

4.en: Paul warns that some will abandon the faith and teach that marriage and certain foods must be refused, though everything God created is good. He urges Timothy to train himself in godliness, to be an example to the believers, and to devote himself to Scripture and teaching.
4.sw: Paulo anaonya kwamba baadhi wataiacha imani na kufundisha kwamba ndoa na baadhi ya vyakula lazima vikataliwe, ingawa kila kitu alichoumba Mungu ni chema. Anamhimiza Timotheo ajizoeze katika utauwa, awe mfano kwa waamini, na ajitoe kwa Maandiko na mafundisho.
4.am: ጳውሎስ አንዳንዶች እምነትን ትተው ጋብቻንና አንዳንድ ምግቦችን መከልከል ይገባል ብለው እንደሚያስተምሩ ያስጠነቅቃል፤ እግዚአብሔር የፈጠረው ሁሉ ግን መልካም ነው። ጢሞቴዎስ ራሱን በእግዚአብሔርን መምሰል እንዲያሠለጥን፣ ለአማኞች ምሳሌ እንዲሆንና ራሱን ለመጻሕፍትና ለትምህርት እንዲሰጥ ያሳስበዋል።

5.en: Paul tells Timothy how to treat different groups in the church: older and younger men and women, widows who are truly in need, and younger widows. He also gives instructions about honoring, accusing and appointing elders.
5.sw: Paulo anamwambia Timotheo jinsi ya kuyashughulikia makundi mbalimbali katika kanisa: wanaume na wanawake wazee na vijana, wajane walio na uhitaji kweli, na wajane vijana. Pia anatoa maagizo kuhusu kuwaheshimu wazee, kuwashtaki na kuwateua.
5.am: ጳውሎስ በቤተ ክርስቲያን ውስጥ ያሉትን የተለያዩ ወገኖች፣ ሽማግሌና ወጣት ወንዶችንና ሴቶችን፣ በእውነት የተቸገሩ መበለቶችንና ወጣት መበለቶችን፣ እንዴት መያዝ እንዳለበት ለጢሞቴዎስ ይነግረዋል። ሽማግሌዎችን ስለ ማክበር፣ ስለ መክሰስና ስለ መሾምም መመሪያ ይሰጣል።

6.en: Paul gives instructions for slaves and warns against false teachers who see godliness as a way to make money, for the love of money leads to ruin. He charges Timothy to pursue godliness and faith, tells the rich to be generous, and urges Timothy to guard what has been entrusted to him.
6.sw: Paulo anatoa maagizo kwa watumwa na kuonya dhidi ya walimu wa uongo wanaoona utauwa kama njia ya kupata fedha, kwa maana kupenda fedha huleta maangamizi. Anamwagiza Timotheo afuatilie utauwa na imani, anawaambia matajiri wawe wakarimu, na kumhimiza Timotheo alinde kile alichokabidhiwa.
6.am: ጳውሎስ ለባሪያዎች መመሪያ ይሰጣል፤ እግዚአብሔርን መምሰልን ገንዘብ ማግኛ መንገድ አድርገው ስለሚያዩ ሐሰተኛ አስተማሪዎችም ያስጠነቅቃል፤ የገንዘብ ፍቅር ወደ ጥፋት ይመራልና። ጢሞቴዎስ እግዚአብሔርን መምሰልንና እምነትን እንዲከታተል አደራ ይለዋል፤ ሀብታሞች ለጋሶች እንዲሆኑ ይነግራቸዋል፤ ጢሞቴዎስም በአደራ የተሰጠውን እንዲጠብቅ ያሳስበዋል።
